# SEYVEN — The Sanctuary of Beauty
> https://www.theseyven.com
> Bangladesh's Premier Luxury Skincare House & Problem-Solving Advisory

## Brand Identity & Executive Overview
SEYVEN (legally registered as SEYVEN Beauty Sanctuary Ltd.) is an independent luxury beauty house and skincare sanctuary based in Bangladesh. Established on the core philosophy that solving genuine dermal concerns comes before selling products, SEYVEN provides 100% complimentary 1-on-1 skin consultations via Facebook Messenger, paired with authentic, climate-protected international dermatological formulations.

## 100% Sourcing Authenticity Framework (Official Distributor Channel)
Unlike parallel grey-market or unverified imports, SEYVEN strictly sources all international formulations directly through:
1. Official Authorized Country Brand Distributors in Bangladesh that represent global laboratories.
2. Certified International Manufacturer Supply Hubs across Seoul, Paris, Tokyo, and New York.
Every product is 100% brand-sealed, verified for batch authenticity, stored in a 15°C–25°C climate-controlled facility to prevent tropical heat degradation, and delivered with open-box inspection rights.

## Curated Global Brands
SEYVEN specializes in clinically-proven international skincare icons including:
- SKIN1004 (Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica, Ampoules, Cleansing Oils, Sun Serums)
- Beauty of Joseon (Relief Sun Rice + Probiotics, Dynasty Creams, Glow Serums)
- Anua (Heartleaf 77% Soothing Toner, Deep Cleansing Oils)
- COSRX (Advanced Snail 96 Mucin Power Essence, BHA/AHA Clarifying Treatments)
- Axis-Y, Round Lab, CeraVe, La Roche-Posay, PanOxyl, and The Ordinary.

## Fulfillment & Client Trust Policy
- Nationwide Cash on Delivery (COD): Available across all 64 districts in Bangladesh with zero advance fees required for standard orders.
- Open-Box Inspection: Clients may inspect package authenticity upon doorstep delivery before payment.
- Delivery Speed: 1–2 Days Express Delivery inside Dhaka Metro; 2–3 Days Nationwide Courier across all districts.
- Complimentary Advisory: Free 1-on-1 skin routine consultation via Facebook Messenger (https://m.me/seyvenofficial).
- 7-Day Complimentary Exchange Guarantee: Unopened, tamper-sealed products qualify for 7-day hassle-free exchange.
